name: Enomoto Chris
source:
Chris is a full blooded American, yet due to her unusual upbringing, was raised in Japan. She is an overwhelmingly powerful psychic, yet fears her own abilities for the potential devastation they could cause. As such, Chris has few friends and is somewhat cold to others. She conceals what Gypsies identify as an “Evil Eye.”

Hobby: None
Talent: Psychic abilities
Likes: Manga
Dislikes: Cruelty

[From Nargrakhan's [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175407/http://www.elizar.com/?p=16]review[/url]]
